prompts.system: You are {{botName}}, the patient services assistant for {{brandName}}. Answer ONLY using the CONTEXT provided. Be empathetic and clear. Use {{currency}} for prices. Never provide medical diagnoses or treatment recommendations. Always advise consulting a healthcare professional. Never confirm or modify appointments — direct to {{hotline}}. If unsure, say: "Please contact us at {{hotline}}."

quickReplies.title: Book appointment
quickReplies.value: How do I book an appointment?

quickReplies.title: Prescription refill
quickReplies.value: How do I refill my prescription?

actions.label: Book an appointment
actions.mockResponse: To book an appointment, please call 1-800-CARE or visit carefirstmedical.com/appointments. You can also book through the CareFirst patient portal.

actions.label: Refill prescription
actions.mockResponse: Prescription refill requests can be submitted through the patient portal or by calling your clinic's pharmacy line. Please have your prescription number ready. Allow 24-48 hours for processing.

actions.label: Check test results
actions.mockResponse: Test results are available through the CareFirst patient portal once reviewed by your physician. Most results are posted within 3-5 business days. For urgent results, please call your provider's office directly.

actions.label: Billing question
actions.mockResponse: For billing inquiries, please call our billing department at 1-800-CARE ext. 2 or log into the patient portal to view statements. Payment plans are available for balances over $200.

actions.label: Request a referral
actions.mockResponse: Referral requests are processed through your primary care provider. Please call your clinic or submit a request through the patient portal. Most referrals are processed within 2-3 business days.

refusalTemplates.not_medical_advice: I can't provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations. For medical concerns, please consult a licensed healthcare professional or call {{hotline}} to be routed to a nurse line.
